summary: Ran live API regression coverage and mobile preview checks. Four backend tests passed; Expo auth screen loads at 375px and prior permission-denied safety behavior remains implemented.

minor.issue: MongoDB rejects $near inside count_documents; nearby_users_notified falls back to 0 even when nearby users may exist.

action_items: Replace blood-request nearby count_documents($near) with a supported geospatial query/aggregation so nearby selection and notification counts are accurate.
Remove admin panel localhost fallback and require its configured VITE_API_URL for deployed builds.
Confirm frontend API configuration intentionally uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, or align it with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend has development defaults for Mongo URL, DB name, JWT secret, and admin credentials; production configuration should fail fast when required variables are absent.
Admin UI has a hardcoded localhost API fallback, which can break the production panel if VITE_API_URL is missing.
seed_data_creation: Created test users and records using TEST-prefixed contact data; no seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: APITXT is configured and OTP reports provider_status=sent in this environment; tests accept either sent or explicitly labelled fallback. Razorpay/WhatsApp/push remain MOCKED/disabled where credentials are absent.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/blood-requests attempts db.users.count_documents with a location $near predicate. MongoDB permits $near for sorted geospatial finds but rejects it in count_documents, producing the logged Location5626500 warning; the handler catches it and silently returns nearby_users_notified=0.
